title: Unified stop/go gate criteria for candidate generation → verifier → training pipeline

stage_1_candidate_generation.description: Candidate generation method evaluation. Only after passing this gate, proceed to verifier.

stop.action: STOP — candidate generation method is not viable. Do NOT expand samples, do NOT train verifier.

smoke_only.action: SMOKE ONLY — limited samples ok for analysis, but not worth systematic eval or verifier training.

systematic_eval.action: EXPAND — run on full DAVIS, analyze per-video breakdown, enter verifier design.

pass.action: PASS — meets original Phase 2 pre-registered threshold. Proceed to Phase 3 verifier.

stage_2_verifier.description: Verifier / selector / acceptor. Only enter if stage 1 passes and top1miss-top5hit is non-zero.
prerequisites: top1 miss but top5 hit @16px > 0% (verifier has input to work with)
stop_conditions: top1 miss but top5 hit @16px == 0%: no verifier value — GT is never in candidate set
verifier cannot beat raw similarity baseline on recall

stage_3_training.description: Re-detection-first training. Only enter after both candidate generation and verifier pass.

stage_1_candidate_generation.state: FAILED — all tested variants below stop threshold
stage_1_candidate_generation.next: Test local-global hybrid with CoTracker3 offline prior
